decision.title: JNode making may fail with a lazy value's error (P7)
decision.summary: The contracts of sxml_json_node_make_root and sxml_json_node_make_child list a lazy value's generator failures, returned without an error record, since both count their value's items.

body.p: by packet , on the orchestrator's acceptance of P7 (option "amend contract"; design edit to include/sxml/xdm.h, comments only). sxml_json_node_make_root and sxml_json_node_make_child count their value's items, so a lazy value's generator may fail inside them; both contracts now list those failures. They take no error record, so the status comes without one: callers that need the error read the value first. The evaluator never makes lazy sequences whose generator evaluates IR (), and it reads values completely before fn:jtree sees them.
